array.string: K=$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s digithings -a paperclip-api-key -w 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$K" ]; then D=$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s digithings -a paperclip-api-key-rotate-by -w 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$D" ] || [ "$D" -le "$(/bin/date +%s)" ]; then echo "$(/bin/date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) routine-watch: PAPERCLIP_API_KEY withheld, rotation deadline missing or passed. Rotating the credential is Security's call (DIG-780); continuing read-only."; K=; fi; else echo "$(/bin/date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) routine-watch: no credential in the login keychain (digithings/paperclip-api-key); continuing read-only. Store one with kit/bin/dt-paperclip-key store --force."; fi; if [ -n "$K" ]; then export PAPERCLIP_API_KEY="$K"; fi; unset K D; exec /usr/bin/python3 /Users/chrisstefan/paperclip-workspace/kit/bin/dt-routine-watch
